name: showDataTable
label: Show data table
description: Shows a table with chart and graph data for easier screen reader access.

name: chartSize
label: Chart size
description: Sets the size of the chart.

name: valueLabelSize
label: Value label size
description: Sets the size of the value.

name: enableDrilldown
label: Enable drilldown
description: When selected, enables an event handler to allow users to click a visualization value or section.

name: showZero
label: Show 0 when no data available
description: Choose the display format when there is no value in the selected dataset or for the configuration.

name: minValue
label: Min value
description: Start value of the dial scale. If not set defined automatically.

name: maxValue
label: Max value
description: End value of the dial scale. If not set defined automatically.

name: innerRadius
label: Inner radius
description: Decimal number to set the ratio of inner radius to outer radius of the dial chart. Allowed value from 0.7 to 0.95.

name: applyDateRange
label: Apply date range
description: Allows date range filter from filter component or manual configuration to be applied to data visualization.
